rawRows: DGO Digital OPS SharePoint Provisioning Source Workbook
This workbook is the source-of-truth workbook for creating the SharePoint persistence lists, fields, seed records, and Power Automate provisioning flow inputs.
Original 10-list structure retained; manifest-driven Power Automate provisioning.
Action names, URIs, methods, headers and expressions
• Use the Lists, Fields, and SeedItems sheets as the source for creating everything in Power Automate.
• The Fields sheet contains the full SchemaXml required for SharePoint createfieldasxml.
• Do not change internal names after provisioning; SharePoint internal names are operational identifiers.
• Power Automate loops that create fields and seed items should run with degree of parallelism = 1.
• This workbook preserves the original 10-list data model and does not collapse or redesign the structure.
